The focused app_server regression now proves an empty root completion emits a root-scoped turn_done frame and the existing child isolation regression proves child completion cannot close the root turn.

contract_hash=sha256:4df7c9f48dc5614aff3e3e66fad0b4d86c9007ef137d4dd9d901d708062580bc; app_server.rs emits an explicit turn_done lifecycle frame only for root turn/completed notifications, commands.rs stops the started session on every rejected or missing native resume result before refreshing the snapshot while retaining the resume error, and journal.rs adds the additive turn_checkpoints_json column with roundtrip restore plus NULL legacy-row compatibility.
